scope: Historical design comparison only; not the selected four-motion product asset and not terminal acceptance.

localHarnessAnimation.entrypoint: RunningWhaleTail and its embedded base64 PNG CSS mask
localHarnessAnimation.verificationMethod: Decoded the CSS mask and confirmed byte identity with the earlier extracted APNG; read IHDR, acTL and all fcTL chunk delays. No animation playback test rerun.
localHarnessAnimation.recheckLimit: Source fingerprint and parsed metadata are archived, not the complete local Harness bundle or its image. Byte-level reproduction requires the exact source identified above.

initialVisualComparison.whatItShows: Browser prototype with the original image and a four-column, one-row braille conversion shown side by side below it.
initialVisualComparison.interpretation: The author judged the one-row conversion to lose the whale-tail outline; this is a visual assessment, not a measured fidelity score or a verbatim user verdict.
initialVisualComparison.userDecision: The user explicitly included terminal image support to retain the original whale-tail appearance.
initialVisualComparison.captureLimit: Static historical browser screenshot; no live animation, terminal rendering, or later revised visibility behavior proven.
